transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with episodes where I eat massive amounts of food in a short period of time. When this happens, I feel completely out of control and like I just can't stop myself.
After these episodes of overeating, do you ever do anything to try to prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up, fasting, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things to try to prevent weight gain. I've never forced myself to throw up, fasted, or exercised excessively after an episode.
How often do these eating episodes typically happen, and for how many months or years have you been experiencing them?
This has been going on for about a year now. Currently, these episodes happen at least once a week, and it has been that frequent for the last three months or so.
During these episodes, do you experience things like eating much faster than normal, eating until you feel uncomfortably full, or feeling very guilty and upset with yourself afterward?
I haven't really noticed eating much faster than normal, and I don't think I get uncomfortably full. I also don't really experience feeling guilty or upset with myself afterward.
Do you often find yourself eating these large amounts of food even when you aren't feeling physically hungry, or do you tend to eat alone because you feel embarrassed by how much you are eating?

Yes, I definitely find myself eating huge amounts of food even when I don't feel physically hungry at all. I also almost always eat alone because I feel deeply embarrassed about how much I'm consuming.
Do these episodes of overeating cause you significant distress, or do they interfere with your daily life and well-being?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in terms of causing distress or interfering with my daily life in that way.
When you think about these eating episodes, do you ever feel disgusted with yourself, depressed, or very unhappy about them?
I'm not quite sure about that. I haven't really thought about my feelings in that specific way or felt depressed or disgusted with myself because of it.
Do you ever try to restrict your food intake, skip meals, or go on strict diets between these episodes of overeating?
No, I don't really try to restrict my food or skip meals between these episodes. I don't go on any strict diets either.
How do you feel about your body weight and shape, and does it greatly affect how you value yourself as a person?
To be honest, I don't really think about my body weight or shape very much. It isn't really something that affects how I value myself as a person.
Have you ever had a period where your body weight was extremely low for your height, or have you ever struggled with an intense fear of gaining weight?

No, I have never experienced having an extremely low body weight, nor do I have an intense fear of gaining weight. My main struggle is really just with those episodes of eating massive amounts of food where I feel completely out of control.
